# Fewer meetings for remote teams

A team spread over eight time zones has almost no hour when everyone is awake and free.

## Write first

Put a proposal in a document, with the decision it needs and a deadline. People comment when their day allows.

## When to meet

Keep calls for conflict and for welcoming people. A decision that needs a call usually needed a clearer document.
